# NYC-Tron UI

> Independent, themeable UI library for React Native 0.88 and Expo SDK 58 (iOS, Android and web, plus isolated Windows and macOS adapters). 164 public component exports in 22 groups, each imported from its own package subpath. The consuming app owns theme tokens and state. Packages ship as GitHub Release tarballs, not npm. Stability labels follow the owner-confirmed manifest; platform statuses are recorded measurements, not device sign-off.

Rules for agents writing app code with this library:

- Import every component from its subpath, for example `import { Button } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/Button";`. Never import from a package root barrel such as `@nyc-tron/ui` when a subpath exists.
- Style with the app's semantic tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-text`, `border-border`, `rounded-control`); never hardcode colors. The app defines the variables listed in docs/THEME_TOKENS.md for light and dark.
- Keep app state in Zustand stores and pass it in through props; resources stay in refs.
- Use the library components and React Native primitives; do not write raw HTML UI.
- Keep every accessible name, focus order, text scaling and reduced-motion behavior; follow each component's accessibility notes.
- Report a platform as supported only where the entry says so. "not verified" means no recorded measurement.

All files below are generated by tooling/llms.mjs from docs/library/components.json and the documentation catalog; links point at the main branch, and the same paths exist in a checkout.

## Start here

- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/skills/nyc-tron-ui/SKILL.md): when to use the library, imports, theming, accessibility and what not to do
- [Component registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/registry/components.json): machine-readable index; one item per export with import, props, example, accessibility notes, stability and platforms
- [Registry schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/registry/schema.json): JSON Schema for the registry
- [Guides](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/llms/guides.txt): getting started, installation, theming, platform support, migration, changelog, versioning policy, contributing, distribution proposal
- [Full reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/llms-full.txt): every component and guide in one file (about 317 KB); prefer one group file below
